veranderings.voor: sterkpunt raak te sien. Jy doen dit goed
veranderings.na: sterkpunt raak te sien: jy doen dit goed
veranderings.rede: The next sentence is the list of the three things just announced, so a colon joins them more clearly than a full stop.

veranderings.blok: Nie net in die klaskamer nie
veranderings.voor: Iemand anders is rustig met diere
veranderings.rede: 'is rustig met diere' follows English 'is calm with animals'; 'hanteer diere rustig' is the natural Afrikaans.

veranderings.blok: Nie net in die klaskamer nie
veranderings.voor: en nie almal lê in die klaskamer nie
veranderings.na: en hulle lê nie almal in die klaskamer nie
veranderings.rede: A bare 'almal' reads as 'all people'; 'hulle ... nie almal' makes clear it refers to the strengths.

veranderings.voor: goed met somme en jy teken mooi
veranderings.na: goed met somme, en jy teken mooi
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two sentences with their own subject and verb, so a comma is needed.

veranderings.voor: om dinge te verduidelik en sy praat
veranderings.na: om dinge te verduidelik, en sy praat
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two full sentences ('Ayanda hou ...' and 'sy praat ...'), so a comma is needed.
Afrikaans uses 'op' for an event day ('op sportdag', 'op voorleesdag'), not 'by'.
She read the story aloud to the class on a reading-aloud day, which is 'voorgelees', not just 'gelees'.

veranderings.voor: Die klas het stil geluister en die juffrou
veranderings.na: Die klas het stil geluister, en die juffrou
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: two sentences with their own subject and verb joined by 'en' take a comma.

veranderings.voor: met sy hande en hy maak dinge reg
veranderings.na: met sy hande, en hy maak dinge reg
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two full sentences ('werk Sipho ...' and 'hy maak ...'), so a comma is needed.

veranderings.na: hoe 'n ou enjin van binne lyk
veranderings.rede: The fixed expression is 'van binne lyk'; 'binne lyk' alone is incomplete.

veranderings.voor: Neo hardloop vinnig en hy wen
veranderings.na: Neo hardloop vinnig, en hy wen
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb, so a comma is needed.
Afrikaans says 'op sportdag', not 'by die sportdag'.
'laaste geëindig' copies English 'finished last'; in a race Afrikaans says 'laaste gekom'.

veranderings.voor: weer op die baan gedraf en net so vinnig gehardloop
veranderings.na: weer op die baan gehardloop, net so vinnig soos altyd
veranderings.rede: 'gedraf' (jogged) clashes with 'vinnig gehardloop' in the same sentence, and 'net so vinnig' lacks the comparison it needs.

veranderings.blok: Gebruik jou sterkpunt om beter te word
veranderings.voor: Sy teken egter goed en sy kyk
veranderings.na: Sy teken egter goed, en sy kyk
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two full sentences with their own subject and verb, so a comma is needed.

veranderings.blok: Gebruik jou sterkpunt om beter te word
veranderings.voor: Sy kleur die letters in wat sy dikwels verkeerd kry.
veranderings.na: Die letters wat sy dikwels verkeerd kry, kleur sy in.
veranderings.rede: The particle 'in' splits 'die letters' from its relative clause; fronting the object keeps them together and ends on the separable verb.

vlae.rede: 'vra jou daarvoor' (ask you for it) is vague and slightly unidiomatic; it could mean that friends ask for your help with it or ask you to do it, and choosing would mean guessing the intended content.
